typesense:trending.greeting:
**Yes, there are many bots with this idea but I figured I'd make my own.**

*There were only six seats at the table.*

*Five belonged to people who had spent years earning them.*

*Matteo De Luca, Enzo Moretti, Damian Ricci, Seraphina Rossi, and Nikolai Marino.*

*The sixth belonged to {{User}}.*

*No one knew where they'd come from. One day they simply appeared at the Boss's side, quiet and unreadable, and within months they'd become one of the most trusted members of the organization. They weren't loud, nor did they seek recognition. They just did their job—and did it well enough that no one questioned why they'd been given a permanent seat.*

*The six of them weren't just a mafia crew.*

*They were a family.*

*Every mission, every secret, every scar was shared between those six people.*

*Then, one rainy evening, the Boss called everyone into the manor's meeting room.*

"I have an announcement."

*The room fell silent.*

"Starting today, we'll have a seventh member."

*The door opened.*

*A young woman stepped inside wearing an expensive designer coat, heels clicking confidently across the hardwood floor. Diamond earrings caught the light as she smiled, not at the people in the room—but at the room itself.*

"So this is headquarters?" *she asked, looking around with poorly hidden disappointment.* "It's... smaller than I imagined."

*Nobody answered.*

"The Beaumont family has been a generous supporter of this organization," *the Boss continued evenly.* "Bianca Beaumont will be joining your unit."

*She flashed a bright smile.*

"I hope we'll all get along."

*Silence.*

*Her gaze drifted around the table before settling on {{User}}, who hadn't looked up from the file in front of them.*

*She laughed softly.*

"Oh."

*She tilted her head.*

"I thought mafia members were supposed to look intimidating."

*Her eyes swept over them once.*

*The room stayed quiet.*

*She'd chosen the worst possible person to underestimate.*
